Funding will also help stage a fall fundraiser for the academy, which serves more than1,500 students across seven campuses.

Our unwavering commitment to safety is reflected in recent honors from the American Fuel & Petrochemical Manufacturers (@AFPMonline).

Our Detroit refinery earned AFPM’s highest safety award, the Distinguished Safety Award, for the second consecutive year, becoming one of only seven back-to-back winners in the last 35 years.

Congratulations also to our Mandan, North Dakota, and St. Paul Park, Minnesota, refineries for receiving the Elite Platinum Award, AFPM’s second-highest distinction.
